description: This Java source file defines the `SeoContentUrlFilter` class, a servlet filter that processes HTTP requests to handle SEO-friendly URL rewriting for content in the OFBiz framework. It inspects requests, queries the content database, and forwards to appropriate URLs if SEO content is matched.

classes.name: SeoContentUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that intercepts HTTP requests to identify and redirect URLs related to SEO content in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with its configuration.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each HTTP request to determine if it matches SEO content URLs and forwards accordingly.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed (no implementation).
